title: Codex
intro: OpenAI's Codex CLI in exec mode, on any provider that speaks the Responses API (OpenAI by default). Thread ids are kept for continuation; reasoning effort, summary, verbosity and a JSON schema for the answer all pass through.

verified.how: hg harness run against OpenAI, two turns

notes: The provider must speak the Responses API (api: openai-responses): Codex's wire_api is responses only.
Codex's own sandbox is set to danger-full-access: the platform's sandbox is the boundary.
MCP servers in the request's tools are written into config.toml as [mcp_servers.<label>] with a bearer token from the environment.
